items.q: How much does custom software development cost?
items.schemaAnswer: Project budgets usually start around EUR 10,000. The final estimate depends on scope, architecture, integrations, technical risk, and delivery model. Before estimating, we define the core workflows, technical risks, architecture direction, and a realistic delivery range. For evolving work, hourly or monthly collaboration may be the right model. Defined scopes can use milestone-based delivery.

items.q: How long does it take to build an MVP?
items.schemaAnswer: Most focused MVPs take 8–14 weeks, depending on feature complexity, product clarity, integration depth, and security or compliance needs. We move quickly without building a throwaway foundation. The goal is a production-ready first release your team can learn from and evolve.

items.q: Do you work with clients internationally?
items.schemaAnswer: Yes. ARG is based in Portugal and works remotely with teams across regions. We rely on clear written context, direct technical conversations, predictable async updates, and enough overlap for decisions. If the problem is clear and ownership is real, distance is not the blocker. Hybrid or on-site collaboration is assessed case by case.

items.schemaAnswer: Both. We support startups building launch-ready products, companies modernizing fragile systems, teams scaling performance or reliability, and organizations building internal platforms. The common thread is technical ownership, not company size.

items.q: How do you ensure scalability and code quality?
items.schemaAnswer: Quality starts before implementation. We make architecture boundaries, testing strategy, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, recovery paths, security, and data constraints explicit so the software can evolve instead of being rewritten after year one. Testing tools vary by stack, but common choices include Jest, Cypress, Playwright, Testcontainers, xUnit, and NUnit.
